_fixtureNote: RaceLens weather venue table, compiled 2026-10-23. Coordinates: see each venue's coord.source/confidence (Wikipedia-sourced = high; memory = low, cross-checked against the locality centroid). BOM stations: nearest AWS computed with the haversine formula from github.com/opennem/opennem opennem/data/bom_stations.json (790 stations: name, BOM site id, lat/lng to 2 dp, fwo JSON feed URL) - distances are therefore accurate to ~1 km. TAB venueMnemonic is filled ONLY where a recorded response or community code evidences it; otherwise null - resolve at runtime from TAB's meetings list using `aliases`. `sampleOpenMeteoResponse` is the constructed Flemington forecast (also saved as open-meteo-forecast.flemington-2026-10-24.json).

coordinateConfidenceLegend.medium: independent community table or transport/heritage marker agreeing within ~1 km, or a station proxy <1 km from the course
coordinateConfidenceLegend.low: model memory, within ~6 km of the locality centroid; fine for a 10-15 km weather grid, verify before finer use
